# Stillage Storage Solutions (stillagestoragesolutions.co.uk)

> Direct UK manufacturer and online supplier of heavy-duty steel stillages, double-sided cantilever bar storage racks, modular stackable hopper bins, mesh security cages, and demountable post pallets. Engineered in British box-section steel and compliant with UKCA, PUWER 1998, and BS EN ISO 1461 standards.

## Quick Facts & Entity Identity
- **Official Name**: Stillage Storage Solutions
- **Website**: https://stillagestoragesolutions.co.uk
- **Manufacturing Hub**: Wrexham Industrial Estate & UK Midlands Steel Fabrication Hub
- **Trade Desk Telephone**: 01978 800 500 (Mon–Fri 07:30–17:00 GMT)
- **Sales & Engineering Email**: sales@stillagestoragesolutions.co.uk
- **Standard Coating**: RAL 5010 Stillage (Gentian) Blue industrial finish
- **Optional Finishes**: Hot-Dip Galvanised to BS EN ISO 1461 (+£45/unit), Custom Corporate RAL (+£25/unit), Raw Unpainted Mill Steel (-£10/unit)
- **Bulk Trade Tiers**: Automatic 5% discount on 5+ units; 10% discount on 10+ units
- **UK Freight**: Up to 4 stillages ship per oversized HGV pallet space nationwide across UK Zones A–D, with optional Lorry Tail-Lift & Pump Truck offload (+£15 Ex. VAT)
- **Payment Options**: Instant online Stripe Checkout or 1-click official B2B UK 20% VAT Proforma Invoice
